messages:
emily: Heads up  customer legal asks about migrating contracts if we consolidate tiers. they want explicit SLA language for legacy pricing.
rahul: We should draft a contract amendment template. Legal: what are the must-haves?
legal-bot: Required: effective date, scope of affected customers, grandfathering duration, credits/fees reconciliation, termination rights, signature block.
tess: Product: propose 6mo grandfather + option to opt-in early with credits. avoids forcing customers to accept changes.
greg: Sales: if legal requires >6mo we lose flexibility. customers pushing back. suggest 4mo but allow up to 12mo for enterprise with exec sign-off.
emily: We need a clear cost-recovery clause for migration SOWs. ops must estimate hours for support and bill accordingly.
rahul: Also include a clause for "feature parity" i.e., if we deprecate addons that customer uses, we must provide equivalent or better baseline for new tier.
legal-bot: Flagged: data residency and auditability must be preserved. update amendment template to reference customer's existing residency clause.
tess: Can someone draft the first pass? I'll iterate.
emily: I'll take a stab and share in #legal-review.
rahul: One more: require a grace period for billing disputes tied to migration for 60 days.
legal-bot: Noted. Template version 0.1 created and uploaded to /contracts/scratch.
emily: Linking to product runbook once done. aim to close template review in 72h.
rahul: We'll need a signature workflow - legal and sales ops to confirm.
tess: OK schedule review with sales ops tomorrow.
greg: Need talking points for reps - short bullet list on why this benefits customer (simpler pricing, bundled savings, predictable quotas).
emily: I'll coordinate messaging.
rahul: End-state: amendment template + playbook + SOW rate card. deliverables due EOW.
legal-bot: Reminder: store final signed amendments in central contracts repo.
